about_the_game:
Welcome to the house where of your dreams!

Having moved in here, you'll find yourself at the center of attention for two eccentric and very friendly futanari roommates. Your goal is not only to keep the house clean but also to build a relationship with each of them.

You are in for a story with management elements, where your choices will determine how these relationships unfold.

Unlock the hearts and secrets of the inhabitants of this unique place.

Features:

  • A furry futanari visual novel / dating simulator

  • Choices-driven branching narrative

  • Two romantic interests

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work.
